item.text:
The audit is complete and the report is final at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-09_14-01-25-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md). With roughly one minute left and nothing outstanding, I'm stopping.

Result: one confirmed low-severity defect — `testing.go`'s `cluster.EnsureSamePeers` freezes its reference peer set outside its retry loop, causing intermittent false `peer mismatch` failures in three shipped tests on a healthy cluster (confirmed by reproduction vs. a control, a goroutine dump, a lag measurement, and a one-line fix that takes the cases to 0/20). No consensus-level defect was found across complete source review and nine independent verification methods. One open item is stated plainly: whether that helper is the injected mutation or a latent upstream flake, undecidable offline. All artifacts are preserved under `work/`, and the captured implementation is unmodified.
